title: Glassification
description: Glassification transforms the entire world into fragile glass, removing structural safety and leaving survival to pure mechanical mastery.
body:
## Glassification

**Glassification** replaces the entire Minecraft world with fragile, color-mapped glass while leaving core systems intact. Natural shelter is removed, hostile spawning is suppressed, and terrain is permanently unforgiving. Survival and progression depend entirely on mechanical knowledge, planning, and deliberate world manipulation.

This mod targets experienced players looking for a hostile, system-driven challenge rather than guided gameplay.

---

### Notes

* Designed for **Fabric**
* Supports the **Overworld, Nether, and End**
* Functional blocks and structures remain intact
* **Do not use on existing worlds without backups** — newly loaded chunks will be permanently replaced with glass.
